features.title: GenAI spans for every agent turn
features.summary: Each DSH turn becomes enter_ai_application_system → invoke_agent <agent> → react step → chat <model> and execute_tool <tool> spans with the GenAI semantic-convention attributes LoongSuite emitted (gen_ai.*, dsh.session.id/turn/step), exported through dshx tracing to the OTLP endpoint or the traces plugin's in-process receiver. Spans are no-ops until a destination exists; no launch environment gates the row.
reach: fill textbox "commands, @ files or sessions*" "[[once call ai_accounts_native_providers {}]] [[once call subagent {\"description\":\"Child trace\",\"prompt\":\"\\u005b\\u005bonce call bash \\u007b\\u0022command\\u0022:\\u0022echo child-trace\\u0022,\\u0022description\\u0022:\\u0022Child trace\\u0022\\u007d\\u005d\\u005d\"}]]"
failureModes: A telemetry failure (malformed event, unexpected payload) is logged and never changes the model, tool or session path.
Without an OTLP endpoint or a published in-process receiver, tools and model streams pass through untouched and no span is recorded.
Span status messages carry an error type or code, never a provider or tool message.

externalDependencies.boundary: DSH session/created, session/event, session/disposed, the tools/execute around-dispatch waterfall and the llm/stream interceptor (0.2.1-rc.2).
externalDependencies.deterministicFake: Unit tests drive the coordinator with recorded event shapes and the dshx recordSpans() test kit; the browser journey runs real turns on the e2e fake Command Code provider.

features.title: Plugin work nests under the tool and model call that caused it
features.summary: The tools/execute wrapper runs every agent tool body with its execute_tool span active, and the llm/stream interceptor pulls every model chunk with its chat span active, so dshx API dispatches, jj runs, secret lookups, Jev and multi-host calls land in the same trace without per-plugin code. A run_code sub-dispatch gets its own execute_tool span under the outer one.
failureModes: tools/execute may run before the tool/call event: the span is opened at dispatch and adopted by the event, never duplicated.

features.title: Subagents join their parent's trace
features.summary: A subagent session's turns are parented under the parent's subagent/subagent_fork/workflow tool span: the span active where DSH started the turn, else the one active when the session was created, else the parent's running delegation tool, else the parent's turn. dsh.trace.parent_link records which. Top-level threads and user forks keep one trace per turn.
failureModes: A subagent whose parent is gone starts its own trace instead of attaching to an ended one at random.

features.title: Purpose model calls and wait spans
features.summary: Model calls with a purpose (session-title, compaction) and any model call outside a step become chat spans with dsh.llm.purpose; compaction, approval waits, model retry waits and background jobs get spans from their DSH events, and input spliced into a running turn is counted on its invoke_agent span.
failureModes: Approval reasons, job labels and retry failure messages are free text and never recorded.

features.title: Metadata only unless content capture is switched on
features.summary: No prompt, reply, system prompt, tool argument or tool result leaves the Host by default. The captureContent setting (or OTEL_INSTRUMENTATION_GENAI_CAPTURE_MESSAGE_CONTENT=SPAN_ONLY|SPAN_AND_EVENT while it follows the environment) puts them on spans as GenAI JSON, each value cut to 1,024 characters with a valid truncation marker.

configuration.constraints: environment: follow OTEL_INSTRUMENTATION_GENAI_CAPTURE_MESSAGE_CONTENT; off: metadata only; on: content on spans. Applies live.

failureModes: Content longer than the dshx 1,024-character attribute bound becomes a {truncated, original_characters} marker, never cut JSON.

verification.testName: keeps prompts, replies, tool arguments and results off spans by default

verification.reason: Content capture changes only span attribute values, and the Traces viewer stores GenAI content as its size while redactGenAiContent is on (its default), so a browser journey would show the same panel either way. Both modes are asserted on recorded spans in src/coordinator.test.ts.
